answer: Census-pulse bond stops mass fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits on a glacier roll, one saffron plot, a vertex checkpoint. Each epoch answer with a receipt tied to the vertex or lose 20; a second miss burns it. Auditors replay one in ten saffron receipts against the glacier roll, flagging a rented-receipt ring. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and pay 8,000 per epoch: 150,000 in ten epochs vs 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 8 per epoch, keeping their share.
